mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_instance WHERE rule_code=#{code} AND fired_at>=DATE_SUB(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
SELECT id,rule_id,rule_code,instance_severity,fired_at FROM t_alert_instance WHERE id>#{afterId} AND instance_status IN ('FIRING','ACKNOWLEDGED') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_instance SET instance_severity=#{target} WHERE id IN #{id}
